newsitem.title: GERMANY: Leica shares offered at 40-47 dmk in bookbuilding.
newsitem.headline: Leica shares offered at 40-47 dmk in bookbuilding.

text.p: German camera maker Leica Camera Gruppe said on Monday it would offer new shares at a price range of 40 to 47 marks during a bookbuilding period from September 3 through September 11.
The as yet unlisted company, a unit of Switzerland's Leica, issued an offer for shares with total nominal value of 15.58 million marks, at five marks nominal value each.
Leica said the shares would carry full dividend rights for the business year to end March 31, 1997.
The company may issue a further greenshoe package of 2.25 million marks nominal value in shares.
Leica had announced its intention to list its shares on the Frankfurt bourse in April, saying the move would give the 80-year-old company leeway to invest in new technology, products and markets.
Leica raised its sales by 4.7 percent to 240 million marks and operating earnings by 15.3 percent to 16.5 million in the year to March 1996.
